1)
```{r}
library(RSQLite)

conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "database.sqlite3")
```

2)
```{r}
query_professores <- "
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.name
  FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t ON i.id = t.instructor_id
  JOIN sections sec ON t.section_uuid = sec.uuid
  JOIN course_offerings co ON sec.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects s ON sm.subject_code = s.code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  ORDER BY i.name
"

professores_stat <- dbGetQuery(conn, query_professores)
cat("Quantidade de professores:", nrow(professores_stat), "\n")
print(professores_stat)
```

3)
```{r}
query_gpa_professores <- "
  SELECT i.name,
         SUM(gd.a_count * 4.0 + gd.ab_count * 3.5 + gd.b_count * 3.0 + 
             gd.bc_count * 2.5 + gd.c_count * 2.0 + gd.d_count * 1.0) * 1.0 /
         SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + 
             gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS avg_gpa
  FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t ON i.id = t.instructor_id
  JOIN sections sec ON t.section_uuid = sec.uuid
  JOIN course_offerings co ON sec.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
  JOIN grade_distributions gd ON co.uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects s ON sm.subject_code = s.code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  GROUP BY i.id, i.name
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + 
             gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
  ORDER BY avg_gpa ASC
"

gpa_professores <- dbGetQuery(conn, query_gpa_professores)

prof_mais_dificil <- head(gpa_professores, 1)
prof_mais_facil   <- tail(gpa_professores, 1)

cat("Professor mais difícil (menor GPA ponderado):\n")
print(prof_mais_dificil)

cat("\nProfessor mais fácil (maior GPA ponderado):\n")
print(prof_mais_facil)

query_gpa_disciplinas <- "
  SELECT c.number, c.name,
         SUM(gd.a_count * 4.0 + gd.ab_count * 3.5 + gd.b_count * 3.0 + 
             gd.bc_count * 2.5 + gd.c_count * 2.0 + gd.d_count * 1.0) * 1.0 /
         SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + 
             gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS avg_gpa
  FROM courses c
  JOIN course_offerings co ON c.uuid = co.course_uuid
  JOIN grade_distributions gd ON co.uuid = gd.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects s ON sm.subject_code = s.code
  WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name
  HAVING SUM(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + 
             gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) > 0
  ORDER BY avg_gpa ASC
"

gpa_disciplinas <- dbGetQuery(conn, query_gpa_disciplinas)

disciplina_mais_dificil <- head(gpa_disciplinas, 1)
disciplina_mais_facil   <- tail(gpa_disciplinas, 1)

cat("\nDisciplina mais difícil (menor GPA ponderado):\n")
print(disciplina_mais_dificil)

cat("\nDisciplina mais fácil (maior GPA ponderado):\n")
print(disciplina_mais_facil)
```
